summary.content:
Today's selection covers 88 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 48 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Websites are closing their doors to AI agents
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: F-Secure Launches Victim-First Scam Encyclopedia Covering 50+ Types of Consumer Fraud
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, Ars Technica, Dark Reading, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 16 articles published in the last 24 hours
